items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets.
items.why: Returned to practice week after high-ankle; official activation.
items.implication: Immediate WR2/flex start; high upside in return.
items.opportunity: Primary target share for NE offense.

items.text: Eagles placing QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with doctors; sidelined indefinitely due to blood clot. Tanner McKee to start.
items.why: Blood clot; multiple doctor consults Saturday.
items.implication: McKee starts ROS short-term; Eagles pass-catchers and RB situation impacted long-term.
items.opportunity: Increased volume potential for DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks if McKee airs it out; Dameon Pierce lead back.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Sunday along with Jalen Hurts and Will Shipley.
items.why: Hamstring; confirmed on ETR Sunday injury list.

items.text: AJ Brown was QUESTIONABLE on Fri list; later activated and expected to play.
items.why: Ankle; practice return led to activation.
items.implication: Start if rostered; reverse any sit plans.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee if QB need; will be better than thought. Not worried about any Eagles skill players with McKee. Start AJ Brown if active as WR2.
items.implication: Eagles WRs/TE still startable; AJB locked start.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Fri Q add (groin). Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee with 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce but top-4 pass-catchers healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon).
items.why: Practice reports and designations; PIT depth chart thinness; PHI personnel healthy top pass catchers despite RB thin.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; lean Metcalf heavy; trust PHI WRs/TE with McKee; Warren new concern.
items.opportunity: Metcalf route/target share spike in 2-WR; PHI pass-catcher volume stable or up; Pierce goal-line if any.

items.implication: Tyler Huntley or backup QB start; Flowers/Andrews usage shifts.
items.opportunity: Possible checkdown bump to Ravens RBs/TEs.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT with AD Mitchell.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup elevated; sit Breece.
items.opportunity: Handcuff or committee backs get full workload.
Xavier Worthy and TE usage up.

items.implication: HOC backfield shifts to other RBs.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers.
items.opportunity: High target share expected vs weak pass D.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI as WR6; bankable usage.
Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI as RB5; elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA as WR28; ugly matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Seattle pass D problem + shaky QB.
